author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Building or redesigning a website is easier than it has ever been! I tested five different builders that all offer pre-made templates, easy site design tools, and free hosting. They all offer the option to connect your own custom domain, and most have an AI design assistant built in. This video compares the experience to show which is the easiest, which is the fastest, which is the most familiar, and which will scale with you as you grow your business.
